data_fields.name: kill_count
data_fields.donor_constant: DesiredAmount per kill objective; Slain increments by 1 per counted kill

best_idea: A quest is an instance with per-objective state, and the claim is two-phase: every objective can veto before any effect runs, and the reward write either fully places or changes nothing.
decision_why: Frankendom needs the quest as a server instance with a check-then-effect claim and once-per-quest kill credit, but rewards go through the one ledger and timers run on the server tick; keep the veto pass, the cooldown written at claim, and the all-or-nothing write.
acceptance: A quest to clear 2 wolves in the north gate counts only wolves killed inside the gate; a third wolf outside is not counted; a test forces the ledger write to fail and the quest stays claimable with no stage change; a second accept inside the cooldown is refused.
